args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its deployment. Remediation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east by an orchestrator error); the rollback was re-issued and completed successfully. All three regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate 0.2%). v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified.
args.title: checkout-api: rolled back v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after health check failures

trace.final:
Task complete. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after rolling back us-east only). I re-issued the rollback and it completed successfully — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.

3. **Verified recovery**: The service is healthy again across all regions, with the error rate down to 0.2%.

4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: Documents the failed deploy, the rollback (including the partial-failure and retry), current healthy state, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified. The initial incident creation call timed out, but verification via the incidents list confirmed it was created exactly once (the idempotency key prevented a duplicate).
